$comment: Sync state for every upstream Ori Studio ports. Consolidates four pins that
previously lived in four different places and formats.
Two commits are tracked per upstream and they mean different things:
vendored_commit     what third_party/<name>/ actually contains, and what
the parity oracle compiles against. Moves only on a
real re-vendor, never by a drift check.
last_checked_commit how far a drift check has triaged. Moves every run,
whether or not it found work.
Drift checks are run with the upstream-drift skill; see

unported_upstream_features: Apollonius circle drawing tools (MouseHandlerCircleDrawApollonius, MouseHandlerCircleDrawApolloniusRadius), added upstream in PR #505. Vendored but not ported: a product decision about whether Ori Studio wants the tool, not a parity gap.

box-pleating-studio.vendored_commit_note: First commit-level pin for this upstream. The previous pin was derived from the vendored package.json version 0.7.14 resolved to its release tag, and confirmed exact: the vendored tree matched that tag file-for-file before the bump to v0.7.15.
open_port_candidates: roughContour.ts stale-contour clear (v0.7.15). May not apply: our layout/contours.rs computes into a fresh result map rather than mutating persistent node state. See implementation-plans/bp-studio-sync-2026-08-10.md.

flat-folder.vendored_subset_note: Unlike the other upstreams this is a curated subset, not a full copy: 20 files, with large images and the upstream example corpus deliberately omitted. A re-vendor must update the vendored files rather than copying the tree.

origami-simulator.vendored_path_note: Not vendored. packages/origami-simulator is a TypeScript port and a WebGL2 modernization, not a copy; the source commit is recorded in its NOTICE file.
